'''Tangtang''' is a featured NPC that appears in the [[Somnium Labyrinth]] [[Event]], she works under Lumi in [[Lollo Logistics]] and appears in the storyline quest of [[Dreamscape Odyssey: Against All Odds]]. During the storyline, Lumi searches for Tangtang in the Somnoire<ref>The [[Somnoire]] is a mysterious and relatively unknown realm in [[Solaris-3]] that is related to dreams.</ref> to assist her in finding a delivery address, worried that Tangtang might have been ambushed by Tacet Discords. However, Tangtang, unharmed apart from a minor scratch, surprises Lumi by coming to look for her instead, fearing that Lumi might have been caught up by the Tacet Discords.
